The Wave

Rippling sand dunes frozen in the Arizona rock.

Marble Canyon, Arizona

About

One of the most recognizable sandstone formations in the American Southwest.

Its striped curves make the hike feel surreal even before the canyon opens up.

Know Before You Go

Visitors need a permit before entering the protected area.

The route is a strenuous 6.4-mile hike with very little shade.
